हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Rocky, a rickshaw driver and underground rapper, goes viral after his stolen song hits YouTube. His tune connects him to Malini, a fallen classical legend who is secretly his real mother. Trained by her, he fuses rap and classical while fighting the powerful Roy family. Betrayed, framed, and enraged, Rocky battles back, exposes the truth on stage, frees his mother, and rises as the new voice of fearless fusion. Watch Now!
